Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 sWhere varchar2(5000);
 sFromTime varchar2(10);
 sToTime varchar2(10);
begin
 default_value(null,'global.sort_by');
 if :control_block.s_site_id is null then
 go_item( 'control_block.s_site_id' );
 show_error( '0080' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 IF :control_block.s_status != 'ALL' THEN
 sWhere := 'donor_schedule.site_id = :control_block.s_site_id ' ||
 ' and donor_schedule.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id '||
 ' and donor_schedule.status = :control_block.s_status ' ; 
 ELSIF :control_block.s_status = 'ALL' THEN
 sWhere := 'donor_schedule.site_id = :control_block.s_site_id ' ||
 ' and donor_schedule.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id '||
 ' and donor_schedule.status != ''CANCL''' ; 
 END IF;
 if :control_block.s_from_date is not null then
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and donor_schedule.sch_date >= :control_block.s_from_date';
 end if;
 if :control_block.s_to_date is not null then
 :control_block.s_to_date := trunc( :control_block.s_to_date ) + 0.99998843; 
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and donor_schedule.sch_date <= :control_block.s_to_date';
 end if;
 if :control_block.s_from_time is not null 
 or :control_block.s_to_time is not null then
 sFromTime := nvl( :control_block.s_from_time, '00:00');
 sToTime := nvl( :control_block.s_to_time, '23:59');
 sWhere := sWhere || 
 ' and to_char( donor_schedule.sch_from_time, ' || 
 in_quotes( 'HH24:MI') || ') >= ' || in_quotes( sFromTime ) ||
 ' and to_char( donor_schedule.sch_from_time, ' || 
 in_quotes( 'HH24:MI') || ') <= ' || in_quotes( sToTime );
 else
 sWhere := sWhere || 
 ' and ( to_char( donor_schedule.sch_from_time, ' || in_quotes( 'HH24:MI') || ') < ' || 
 '( select to_char( nvl( min( time_of_day ), (donor_schedule.sch_from_time + 0.1)), ' || in_quotes( 'HH24:MI') || ') ' ||
 ' from fixed_site_slots ' ||
 ' where fixed_site_slots.site_id = donor_schedule.site_id ' ||
 ' and fixed_site_slots.sch_date = donor_schedule.sch_date ' ||
 ' and fixed_site_slots.proc_code = donor_schedule.proc_code ' ||
 ' and fixed_site_slots.donation_type_group = ' ||
 '( select donation_type_group ' ||
 ' from valid_donation_types ' ||
 ' where valid_donation_types.donation_type = donor_schedule.donation_type )' ||
 ' )' ||
 ' or to_char( donor_schedule.sch_from_time, ' || in_quotes( 'HH24:MI') || ') > ' || 
 '( select to_char( nvl( max( time_of_day ), (donor_schedule.sch_from_time - 0.1)), ' || in_quotes( 'HH24:MI') || ') ' ||
 ' from fixed_site_slots ' ||
 ' where fixed_site_slots.site_id = donor_schedule.site_id ' ||
 ' and fixed_site_slots.sch_date = donor_schedule.sch_date ' ||
 ' and fixed_site_slots.proc_code = donor_schedule.proc_code ' ||
 ' and fixed_site_slots.donation_type_group = ' ||
 '( select donation_type_group ' ||
 ' from valid_donation_types ' ||
 ' where valid_donation_types.donation_type = donor_schedule.donation_type )' ||
 ' )' ||
 ' ) ';
 end if;

 set_block_property( 'donor_schedule', default_where, sWhere);
 set_block_property( 'donor_schedule', order_by, :global.sort_by);
end;

PROCEDURE time_format_function( input_str in varchar2,
 output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

 string_length := NVL( length( input_str), 0) ;

 if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr( input_str, 3, 1) = ':' then
 if to_number( substr( input_str, 1, 2)) > 23 
 or to_number( substr( input_str, 4, 2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 elsif string_length = 4 then
 if to_number( substr( input_str, 1, 2)) > 23 
 or to_number( substr( input_str, 3, 2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 output_str := substr( input_str, 1, 2) || ':' || 
 substr( input_str, 3, 2) ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select drives.drive_id, name 
from drives, drive_sponsors ,sponsors 
where name like '%'||nvl(:control_block.s_drive_id,'')||'%' 
and location_id = nvl(:control_block.pk_site_id, location_id) 
and drives.status = 'CNFRM' 
and drives.drive_date = :control_block.s_drive_date
and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
and drive_sponsors.drive_id=drives.drive_id 
and sponsors.sponsor_id = drive_sponsors.sponsor_id 
and sponsors.chapter_id=drives.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select to_char( a.drive_date, 'MM-DD-RR' ) drv_dt, a.drive_id, c.name, a.drive_date
from drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c where c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id and a.drive_id = b.drive_id and a.status = 'CNFRM' and 
( c.name like '%' || :ctrl_blk_1.driveid || '%' 
 or a.drive_id = :ctrl_blk_1.driveid
)
and drive_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date 
order by a.drive_date desc

 ) 
and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
